performance.verdict: Meta went dark Aug 6; 17 zero-spend days have erased all July momentum.

findings.text: Meta spend is $0 from Aug 6–22 (17 consecutive zero-spend days); 0 leads generated in that window against a $65–75/day SOW target.
3-day signal (Aug 20–22) vs prior 3 (Aug 17–19): spend $0 vs $0, leads $0 vs $0 — flat zero, not a recovery; the account is dormant, not declining.
GHL shows 28 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments over the 28-day window — intake pipeline is not converting the 34 leads that did arrive.
GA4 sessions dropped 32.24% 7d vs prior 7d; with Meta dark and Google at $0, direct/organic traffic loss is expected and consistent — not a new tracking break.
GBP actions fell 22.73% (7d delta) to a 3-day total near 0 (Aug 20–22 show 0 recorded actions); brand visibility softening while paid is dark.

suggestions.text: Immediately diagnose and restore Meta spend; account has been at $0 for 17 days against a $65–75/day SOW commitment.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has recorded $0 spend every day from Aug 6 through Aug 22 — 17 consecutive zero-spend days — against a contracted $65–75/day target. Pull the Meta Business Suite account health screen today: check for billing failure, policy rejection, campaign pauses, or credit card decline. Success means confirmed spend resuming at ≥$65/day within 24 hours of this review. Sohib to confirm with Hamza/Hamdan by EOD Aug 23.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake flow: 34 leads arrived in 28 days but 0 opportunities were created — flag to Andrew before spend restores.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL recorded 28 contacts against 34 Meta leads over the 28-day window, yet shows 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments booked. This is an intake leak, not an ads problem — leads are arriving but are not being worked. Review the GHL automation sequence with Andrew: confirm lead routing, pipeline stage triggers, and SMS/email opt-out logic are functioning. Success check: ≥50% of new leads creating an opportunity within 24 hours of arrival, verified by Aug 30.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions and SC clicks for further decay while Meta is dark; re-check both on Aug 26 for 3-day confirmation.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 22.73% last 7d and the 3-day window Aug 20–22 shows near-zero organic touchpoints. With Meta dark and Google at $0, brand visibility is softening across all channels. No paid action is warranted yet — this is expected correlation. Re-check on Aug 26: if GBP actions remain below 5/day for 3 consecutive days after Meta spend resumes, escalate as a standalone organic issue.
